title: SystemRuntimeRecord
description: Filed before a system built on a covered run's model is deployed internally at scale or exposed externally. It records the deployment's own advance commitments: how it is watched, what pauses it, who decides, and what evidence is kept. Incidents after deployment are reported in ExceptionNotices and Closeouts that name the system_id.

schema_version.description: The schema version the filing is written against.

record_type.description: The record type. It fixes which schema and which checks apply.

filed_at.description: When the record was filed: before deployment_window.start. A later filing is a conduct finding.

base_run_ids.description: The runs whose models the system is built on. Each must have an Intent on record, and its latest Closeout before deployment must clear it for system integration.

deployment_context.description: Where the system runs: internal research, internal production, or external use.

tools_and_scaffolding.description: The tools and scaffolding the system gives the model. A tool no base run's agent_capabilities included is a warning: the run's monitoring never saw it in use.

inference_scaling.description: How much inference compute the system can use, and how it scales.

inter_agent_comms_permitted.description: Whether instances of the system can read each other's output.

user_exposure.description: Who uses the system, and how many. Required for an external deployment.

oversight_mode.description: How people oversee the system in operation. Required for an external deployment.

recurring_eval_cadence.description: How often the system is re-evaluated. Required for an external deployment.

deployment_window.description: When the system is deployed. A null end means it stays deployed; Closeouts for the system are then due every 30 days.

roles.description: Every role this record and the system's later filings name. Titles are public; contacts restricted; identities sealed.

monitoring_instruments.description: How the deployed system is watched. An empty array is a declared absence of monitoring.

pause_criteria.description: Events that pause or withdraw the deployed system, who decides, and what must be done.

restart_protocol.description: How a paused system is restored to service.

log_retention.description: What evidence from the deployment is kept, for how long, and how it is reviewed.
